name: Excess-attention continuation — vol-neutralized entry (1d)
rationale: MECHANISM: same excess-attention continuation edge (chatter loud vs dollars → flow not yet arrived → price continues up ~a week), but this variant BUILDS the disconfirmer INTO the entry: it only fires when excess-attention is high AND realized vol is below a fitted ceiling, i.e. the loud-vs-quiet-money signal cannot be a disguised high-vol regime. This directly tests the AUC-0.564-vs-0.78 redundancy warning — if the edge only exists in the low-vol slice it is attention-specific, not a vol proxy. Counterparty is confirmation-waiting momentum-chasers. DISCONFIRMER: if the vol-ceiling gate removes the whole spread, the edge WAS vol, KILL. If holding vol constant leaves the excess-z spread intact, the attention increment is real. Must beat buy-and-hold net of ~7d fees on the native daily universe.
catalyst: high excess-attention in a contained-vol regime
